title: Japanese-Style Sausage Skillet
description: A quick and easy Japanese-inspired skillet dish featuring juicy sausages and a sweet soy-based sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sausages and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausages from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil and cook the red pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Add the honey to the skillet and stir to combine with the pepper flakes.
Add the cooked sausages back to the skillet and toss to coat with the honey-soy sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sausages are coated and heated through.
